headline: Anthropic adds Dashboards and Motion beta features to Claude
body: Anthropic launched two beta features for Claude. Dashboards turns sources like BigQuery, Snowflake or Salesforce into auto-updating live dashboards from a text prompt, and Anthropic says every number shows its underlying query. Motion creates animated explainer videos from text, diagrams and images, and is available on Team and Enterprise plans.
note: For finance teams, the useful detail is that Anthropic says every number shows its underlying query, which gives a reviewer something to check before a figure reaches a decision.

evidence.text: Anthropic launched two new beta features for Claude.
Dashboards connects data sources like BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, or Salesforce and turns them into auto-updating live dashboards via text prompt.
Every number shows its underlying query, and results can be piped into tools like Amplitude, Grafana, or Hex, Anthropic says.
Motion creates animated explainer videos from text, diagrams, and images, editable as code and exportable as MP4.
Dashboards is available for paid users, Motion for Team and Enterprise plans.
